name: boolean_expression
description: Boolean negation and binary conjunction/disjunction with explicit True/False operands; controls copy an operand.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
prefix='Evaluate Boolean expressions. Return only True or False.\nTrue AND False = False\nFalse OR True = True\nNOT True = False\nNOT False = True\n'
cprefix='Copy the first Boolean value.\nFirst: True; Second: False. Answer: True\nFirst: False; Second: True. Answer: False\n'
for i in range(120):
 a,b=[bool(random.getrandbits(1)) for _ in range(2)]
 expr,v=random.choice([(f'{a} AND {b}',a and b),(f'{a} OR {b}',a or b),(f'NOT {a}',not a)])
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+expr+' =','answer':' '+str(v)})
 control.append({'prompt':cprefix+f'First: {a}; Second: {b}. Answer:','answer':' '+str(a)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
